name: markasso
description: The whiteboard your agents draw on: architecture diagrams, flowcharts and sketches, offline or live on a shared board with people.

interface.shortDescription: The whiteboard your agents draw on
interface.longDescription: Draw architecture diagrams, flowcharts and sketches with automatic layout and icons, export PNG or SVG, share a markasso.it link, or join a live session and draw next to the people on the board.
defaultPrompt: Draw the architecture of this repository with Markasso and give me a share link.
Turn this process into a Markasso flowchart with start, end and decisions.
